extracted.name: Zucchini Bread with Brown Sugar
extracted.description: For this zucchini bread recipe, brown sugar adds a rich, moist, and slightly deeper flavor to this traditional loaf peppered with walnuts and raisins.
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C). Grease and flour two 9x5-inch loaf pans.

Beat eggs in a large bowl until smooth. Add zucchini, brown sugar, oil, and vanilla; mix well. Stir in flour, cinnamon, baking powder, baking soda, and salt until well combined. Stir in raisins and walnuts until evenly distributed. Divide batter between the prepared loaf pans.
Bake in the preheated oven until a toothpick inserted into centers comes out clean, about 1 hour.
